[[Lucent the Spectral]] is one of the remaining Mursaat, guiding the White Mantle, and is one of the four Mursaat giving commands back at the northern village of [[Demetra]]. He is seen in the [[Battle of Lion's Arch]], leading [[White Mantle]] and [[Jade Armor]] forces.
